name: ui.gitPage
description: Git page: the changes of an application named by Entity and instance, staged and committed from the page, its history with refs, its branches created, checked out and left for a detached HEAD, the files of a commit, the diff of a file, the refusals it explains, its remote fetched, pulled and pushed with a token asked once and saved, nothing while git is off, and the creation of a repository, and a repository cloned and installed from the clone panel.

miroirTests.miroirTestLabel: GitPage
GitPage: lists the changes, named by Entity and instance
GitPage: opens on Changes, and shows the branches on their tab
GitPage: opens on the tab named by view
GitPage: opens on Changes for an unknown view
GitPage: lists the commits with their refs
GitPage: shows the last commit, and the history on demand
GitPage: says when the branch has no commit yet
GitPage: shows the diff of a change against HEAD
GitPage: shows the diff of a change on Changes only, and keeps it across tabs
GitPage: keeps the history's selection apart from the change's
GitPage: shows the files of a commit and their diff against its parent
GitPage: shows nothing else while git is off
GitPage: offers to create a repository, then lists the changes
GitPage: offers to create a repository on Changes and Branches
GitPage: stages a change, then commits the staged changes

target.byText: No change since the last commit.

miroirTests.miroirTestLabel: GitPage: keeps the commit message typed before staging
GitPage: asks for the author when the repository has none
GitPage: explains a commit refused while Miroir changes are not saved
GitPage: creates a branch and checks it out
GitPage: checks out a commit as a detached HEAD, then goes back to the branch
GitPage: explains a checkout refused by uncommitted changes
GitPage: asks before deleting a branch with commits of its own

byText.regex: ^feature has commits the current branch does not have

miroirTests.miroirTestLabel: GitPage: shows the remote and how far the branch is from its upstream
GitPage: keeps the branch and the remote in the header on every tab
GitPage: links to Setup when there is no remote
GitPage: shows only the title and Refresh for a folder with no repository
GitPage: fetches, then pulls the commits of the upstream

steps.label: the pulled commit in the history

miroirTests.miroirTestLabel: GitPage: pushes the commit of the branch
GitPage: explains a pull refused because the branches have diverged

byText.regex: ^The branch and its upstream have diverged
^The remote has commits this branch does not have

miroirTests.miroirTestLabel: GitPage: keeps a pull refusal on every tab

byText.regex: ^The branch and its upstream have diverged
^The branch and its upstream have diverged

byText.regex: ^The remote refused this token for git\.example\.com

miroirTests.miroirTestLabel: GitPage: says when a token that worked could not be saved

byText.regex: ^The token worked but was not saved: gitAction_setCredential: a wrapping key is required
